findings.highlight: go to the same university as Io
findings.evidenceJa: 依緒の選んだ学部に行くつもりだった
findings.explanation: Takeya planned to enter the faculty or department Io selected, not merely the same university; the latter is already their shared attached-university path and erases the romantic choice.
findings.japanese:
「あいつ、最初から依緒の選んだ学部に行くつもりだったんだよ」

「え…」

「だからギリギリまで悩んでるふりしてた訳」

「そ、そなんだ」

「まぁ、依緒の方はそんなの知っても知らなくても『だから何』としか言わないんだろうけどな」

「………」

「ほんっと、あいつらって………どした、雪菜？」

「ふぇっ？　え、あ…別に。なんで？」

「いや、いつもの雪菜ならもっと興奮してはやし立てるところかなと…『ね、ね、あの二人、今度こそ上手く行くといいね～』とかさ」

「あ、や…わ、わたし、そんな野次馬っぽい反応しないよ～」

「そうかな…まぁ、雪菜がそう言うんならそうか」
findings.todokanai:
“He was planning from the beginning to go to the same university as Io.”

“What…”

“So he pretended to be mulling it over until the very last minute.”

“I-I see.”

“Of course, whether Io knew or didn’t know about that, she would probably just say, ‘So, what?’…”

“…”

“Those two are really just… What’s up, Setsuna?”

“Huh? Oh, uh… nothing, really. Why?”

“Oh, I just feel like normally you’d be more excited about this… Y’know, ‘Hey, I wonder whether those two will really be able to pull it together this time? I hope so!’ or something.”

“Come on, I… I wouldn’t say a nosy thing like that!”

“Really…? Well, if you say so.”

findings.highlight: they thought back on memories of the past three years
findings.evidenceJa: 三人で過ごした時間も、三年間の思い出の中に組み込まれ
findings.explanation: The New Year time the three just spent is incorporated into their three years of memories; the translation instead has them reminisce during those days.
findings.japanese:
改めて…一月に、なった。

　三が日に、三人で過ごした時間も、三年間の思い出の中に組み込まれ、卒業までのあと少しの時間を、焦ったり、まったりしながら一緒に過ごす。

　それが、三人全員が、誰一人欠けることなく望んだこと…のはずだから。
findings.todokanai:
Yet again… it was January.

In the time the three of them spent together in the first three days, they thought back on memories of the past three years, freaking out and relaxing in turn in the face of the little time that remained until graduation.

Because that was what all three of them, every single one, wanted… supposedly.

findings.evidenceJa: 影を潜めたままだった
findings.explanation: 影を潜める means both women's characteristic forms of chatter remained absent. The literalized 'concealed shadows' leaves the governing proposition unintelligible.
findings.japanese:
「それじゃ、そろそろ…」

「うん…」

　部屋の時計は、十時二十分…別れの時は、いつもより十分も早く訪れた。

　結局、最後まで二人の会話が盛り返すことはなかった。

　ころころと話題が変わる雪菜の気ままなお喋りも、言葉と口調が乖離しっぱなしの、かずさの愛情だだ漏れの悪口も、影を潜めたままだった。

「…おやすみ」

「っ、あ、待ってかずさ！」

「ん？」
findings.todokanai:
“Then, I guess it’s about time for me to…”

“Yeah…”

The clock in her room read 10:20… Their parting time had come ten minutes earlier than usual.

In the end, their conversation never made a comeback.

Setsuna’s freewheeling chitchat, changing topics at the drop of a hat, and Kazusa’s badmouthing that was bursting with affection, her words and tone perpetually divergent from each other, both concealed shadows.

“…Good night.”

“…Ah, wait, Kazusa!”

“Hm?”

findings.highlight: The truth steadily shone through by the white ceiling, the shining fluorescent light.
findings.evidenceJa: その白い天井が、輝く蛍光灯が、じわりと滲んでいってしまう事実を
findings.explanation: The ceiling and fluorescent light gradually blur through Setsuna's tears, which she can no longer hold back. The translation invents an abstract truth shining through and loses the physical onset of crying.
findings.japanese:
「………はぁっ」

　携帯を切ると、雪菜は呆然としたように白い天井を見上げる。

「ぁ…」

　けれどそれは失敗だった。

　なぜなら、上を見てしまっては誤魔化しようがなかったから。

「ぁ、ぁ…」

　その白い天井が、輝く蛍光灯が、じわりと滲んでいってしまう事実を。

　もう自分の力では留め置くことができないという事実を。
findings.todokanai:
“…Whew.”

After she hung up, Setsuna looked up at the white ceiling, as though in a daze.

“Ah…”

However, this was a mistake.

Because, when she looked up, she had no way of avoiding it.

“Ah… Ah…”

The truth steadily shone through by the white ceiling, the shining fluorescent light.

The truth that she could no longer keep locked away by her own effort.
